data.standardized_narrative: Opening (1 January 2016) gross claims outstanding inferred from the Balance Sheet comparative column is approximately GBP 144.553m. The report images reviewed did not contain a clearly labelled gross Movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding figure that could be extracted unambiguously. Narrative references to prior year development or quantified gross prior year movements were not locatable in the provided pages; therefore no reliable gross prior year development amount could be reported.
data.data_quality_notes: Data extraction limited by image quality and rotation. Opening gross claims outstanding was inferred from the Balance Sheet (liabilities: provision for outstanding claims) prior-year comparative column visible on the balance sheet page (page 14) as GBP 144,553 thousand  144.553 million. No unambiguous GROSS 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note or explicit gross prior-year development amount was found in the provided images. The report contains P&L lines such as 'Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' which are NOT the required reserve movement and were therefore not used. Because no gross PYD figure was located, prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. If a net prior-year movement is acceptable, that may be extractable from narrative lines not found here; otherwise a higher-resolution/original PDF is required to extract the detailed movement note, segmental premium mix and claims development triangle.
